purpose: Evaluate whether the frozen prompt candidate transports to the established 120-record regression test corpus.
independence_limitation: The 120-record corpus and its baseline outputs were inspected before the ablation study and informed the initial instability diagnosis; it is therefore a regression test, not an unbiased confirmatory test.
interpretation: Secondary regression evidence only. Results cannot reactivate RC1, revise the sealed-holdout result, or be used for prompt tuning.
production_definition: The production corpus is the complete deduplicated database-retrieval corpus screened after an instrument passes all development, expert-validity, and sealed-stability gates.
